notes.title: FORMIDO
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

My next game, [b]FORMIDO[/b], now has a store page live!

It’s an [i]atmospheric psychological horror and walking simulator[/i]. A slow-burning, immersive experience with a gripping story and a twisted ending that’ll stick with you.

If you're into games with eerie vibes, mysterious companions, and narrative-driven exploration, this one's for you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913230/FORMIDO/

[b]Wishlist it now[/b] to support the game and stay updated!

*Demo very soon*
